title: A model edits a model
subtitle: GPT-6 Astra rewrites a small model's weights, a planted AGENTS.md hijacks agents, and Japan's breach week goes on
editor_note: A model can now edit another model's weights, and a stray file can steer your agent. Check what your tools trust.

sections.headline: A model edits a model
sections.deck: Astra changed 0.016% of a 0.8B model's weights. Math rose up to 6x, with no training.
sections.why: If it replicates, fixing a small model could become an edit, not a training run.

sections.headline: The gain was ending loops
sections.deck: The big math jump came mostly from cutting reasoning loops, not new skill.
sections.why: Read the result as a loop fix first. That is easier to believe and to reuse.
